text:
maya: hitting lots of lateframes on /metrics since the 11:00 canary. metrics pane often freezes 600-1kms.
ben: confirmed, I can repro on prod-canary at 20% :eyes:. flame shows big chunk parsing on main thread.
jordan: any new bundles or change to splitpoints in that deploy?
maya: yeah we shipped a chunk consolidation for the metrics pane to reduce requests; ended up pulling in viz-utils + intl all at once. chunk name: metrics-legacy-aggregate
maya: quick grep from build:
```
import 'viz-utils/legacy'
import 'intl/locale-data'
```
aqib: that import pattern will blow up parse time when cache is cold. bundle went up ~450kb gz.
sara: are we also seeing routing/quota interactions? earlier we saw telemetry fetch retries spike when quotas hit which might add CPU work.
ben: yep — routing policy change last week retries to alternate telemetry backend when quota=throttled; that triggers extra client-side processing during initial render, doubling work in some cases.
maya: disabling telemetry reduces the freeze but parse spike remains. looks like two problems: bundle parse + telemetry fanout.
jordan: short-term mitigation options:
- revert consolidation
- lazy-load viz-utils
- minimal rollback for canary
ben: lazy-load example:
```
const Viz = lazy(() => import(/* webpackChunkName: "viz-async" */ 'viz-utils/legacy'))
```
aqib: also consider pinning prefetch for metrics route: set routePrefetch: none for canary to avoid pulling intl on first paint.
sara: ops: deploy-bot reports canary at 35% and increased error budget burn. recommend pausing canary/roll back if possible.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by sara at 2025-07-12T11:45:20Z — reason: main-thread parse/regressions
maya: I'll open a rollback PR to restore previous chunking, then follow up with a lazy-load PR and a measured canary of that.
ben: also add a server-side flag to short-circuit telemetry heavy paths for canary: TELEMETRY_PREFETCH=false
jordan: and create a small A/B test to compare perceived latency lazy vs consolidated bundle so product can evaluate UX tradeoffs.
aqib: I'll lower routing retries for metrics fetches on canary (retries: 1) to reduce fanout while we validate.
sara: SGTM. can we run a quick E2E and LCP check before resuming canary? need to verify percentiles under SLO.
maya: will push the rollback + smoke job in ~30m and post results here.
ben: :thumbsup: capture the tradeoffs in the rollout ticket (bundle vs fewer requests vs telemetry fidelity).
sara: thanks. ping me when canary resumes or if we need an emergency rollback to prod. :shipit:
